children: Producer prices in Jordan increased 3.64% year-on-year in July 2026, slowing from a 5.27% gain in the previous month.

Price growth moderated sharply in the manufacturing sector, rising 3.55% from 5.82% in June, driven particularly by softer inflation in the manufacture of coke and refined petroleum products, chemicals and chemical products, other non-metallic mineral products, rubber and plastic products, paper and paper products, and motor vehicles, trailers and semi-trailers.
Meanwhile, costs accelerated in mining and quarrying (6.99% vs 1.50%) and electricity, gas, steam, and air conditioning supply (1.91% vs 0.52%).
On a monthly basis, producer prices fell 1.07% in July, easing slightly from a 1.15% decline in the previous month.

title: Jordan Producer Inflation Eases in July
